description: Search a file for nodes by name and by text content (case-insensitive substring), optionally restricted to node types and/or a subtree. Each hit comes back with the page it lives on, a breadcrumb of ancestor names, and which field matched — so you can jump straight to a guid and then call fig_node / fig_style. Omit `query` to list every node of the given types.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous truncated response; resumes where it stopped.

file.description: Path to the .fig / .figma file (absolute, or relative to the server CWD).

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against layer names AND text content.

scope.description: Only search inside this guid subtree. A Figma node-id or link works too.

name: fig_find
title: Search layers and text
